tara (research): quick flag 10-run results for reranker-lite int8: ndcg@10 +1.4% but mrr@1 -2.1% vs baseline fp16.
ben (ml): same seed/harness?
tara (research): yes. cmd: `tools/eval/run --model rerank-lite-int8 --cohort holdout_alpha --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@1 --seed 7`
ci-bot: job 90123 finished: https://ci.redwood.ai/90123 
otis (infra): int8 build used asymmetric-ptq config we landed last week. no kernel revert yet.
mira (prod): any recent changes to doc merging or snippetizer? we rolled a doc-concat change for SERP snippets yesterday.
tara (research): repro quickly: i ran two benches: A) "passage" (each candidate kept separate) B) "concat" (merge top3 passages into one candidate). Observed flips concentrated in concat set. flip-rate(top1 fp16->int8) concat=5.7%, passage=1.0%.
ben (ml): that explains ndcg up / mrr down: int8 tends to narrow score margins, causing more top1 swaps; ndcg tolerates some reordering if later relevant docs rank higher, mrr punishes top1.
otis (infra): possible culprits: score quant rounding, output-clamp we added, or different softmax scaling in int8 runtime. i'll check kernel change list.
tara (research): i dumped 20 examples where int8 bumped a lower-ranked relevant doc to #1. example snippet:
```
# Q: how to reset api key
cand1 (fp16): 4.05 -> softmax 0.72  (rank1)
cand2 (fp16): 3.80 -> softmax 0.18  (rank2)
int8: cand1: 3.98 -> 0.55, cand2: 4.01 -> 0.45  (flip)
# note: score gap shrank from 0.25 to -0.03
```
ben (ml): interesting: scores moved in opposite directions for the pair, not just compression. Could be rounding + small kernel bias. Try linear rescale of int8 logits by 1.025 and recompute metrics.
mira (prod): practically, if top1 is worse for users, we need a mitigation ASAP. Is rescale safe?
otis (infra): low-risk patch if we can keep it in the serving config as a per-model multiplier. i can hotpatch for the staged rollout.
ben (ml): triage plan posted: 1) reproduce locally w/ seed+det deterministic ordering (no random shuffle) 2) ablate concat vs passage 3) rescale sweep [0.98..1.05] 4) run kernel revert test 5) add flip-rate to CI metrics.
tara (research): did 3) quick sweep: multiplier 1.02 recovered ~+1.7% mrr and kept ndcg +1.1%. added flip-rate test: multiplier halves flip-rate on concat.
otis (infra): i'll run kernel revert in staging and compare. queued job 90124.
ci-bot: job 90124 queued: int8-kernel-revert-staging 
mira (prod): thanks. if rescale looks stable across cohorts we can gate the int8 rollout behind it until infra confirms kernel fix. please update the playbook with rollback steps and the per-model multiplier knob. :thumbsup:
ben (ml): also adding tokenization parity check when concatenating: ensure no extra separators/prefix tokens accidentally injected.
tara (research): one more FYI: we saw slightly higher variance on short queries. logging example ids into S3 for further human inspection.
mira (prod): good. ping me on results in morning standup.
